live_anthropic_model_policy.enforcement: Opus is rejected before Anthropic client construction. Research and capability evaluation override every enabled LLM subsystem to the exact Haiku model.

current_change.theory_transport: The same TheoryDeveloper and task now use two bounded provider calls: first a core mathematical workspace, then an executable estimator interface constrained to frozen estimator and semantic-reference IDs. The merged packet is rehashed and validated as one theory artifact. This is transport decomposition, not another agent or scheduler.
current_change.metric_review_transport: The independent pre-execution reviewer receives a compact projection of immutable authority, a single typed array for variable-count theory-scope checks, and runtime-owned prior-finding identity/evidence binding. Local validators still check the full source material and exact coverage.
current_change.semantic_audit: Generic prompts require primitive DGP/estimand reconstruction, full-support expectation or probability expansion, normalization, boundary checks, and alignment with Architect formal/simulation targets. No statistical task formula was added.
current_change.formalizer_strategy: Exact target and assumptions, source-local namespace/module role, dependency-ordered lemma DAG, smallest blocked leaf, real Lean/LSP diagnostics, preservation of verified ancestors, and statement/assumption review after persistent failure. No Lean syntax or tactic repair rule was added.
current_change.formal_rag_queries: When capacity permits, first-turn retrieval now keeps one exact qualified-name query and one separate semantic theorem query before additional exact/support queries. This prevents stale declaration hints from crowding out cross-task semantic retrieval.

ai4slt_formal_rag.organization_reused: Qualified semantic declaration names and layered modules/namespaces for CoveringNumber, MetricEntropy/Chaining/Dudley, Gaussian concentration/LSI, LeastSquares, MatrixInfra, and RMT. Textbook numbers remain citation metadata rather than Lean names or proof policy.
ai4slt_formal_rag.boundary: AI4SLT source, citation, signature, dependency, and train-state hits are candidate context. Toolchain/snapshot identity is disclosed, and every selected declaration or generated action must be re-elaborated in the exact active project before it can contribute to kernel evidence.
